snippet.title: ZERO Sievert 2 | Co-op Sequel Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Zone changes everything. But this time, you won’t face it alone…

We’re proud to officially reveal ZERO Sievert 2! The next evolution of the brutal extraction experience, now featuring multiplayer co-op.

Squad up with friends, venture deeper into the wasteland, and fight to survive in a world that never plays fair. Every decision matters. Every encounter counts. And now, every raid can be shared.

Wishlist now:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4210060/ZERO_Sievert_2/ 
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/zero-sievert-2-b3d2b8

Stay savvy and join our newsletters
ZERO Sievert - http://eepurl.com/hWuO85
